## [code]

```python
from chi.lease import Lease
from datetime import timedelta

reservations = []
lease_node_type = "compute_cascadelake_r"

try:
    print("Creating lease...")
 
    l = Lease(
        name=f"{os.getenv('USER')}-pendulum-fin",
        duration=timedelta(days=0, hours=5),
    )
    
    l.add_fip_reservation(amount=1)
    l.add_node_reservation(amount=1, node_type=lease_node_type)

    l.submit()
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
```
